title: Photograph — two people with donkey cart
text: [Photograph: A vintage black-and-white snapshot showing two people with a donkey and cart. One person, wearing overalls and a wide-brimmed hat, stands in or behind the cart. Another person, in a white top, sits in the front of the small wooden cart. The donkey faces the camera in the foreground. Several houses are visible in the background. No caption or text is present on the image.]
notes: No text visible. Photo appears to be an informal snapshot, likely early 20th century. Identities of subjects unknown.
